item.title: Music and Interoception: How Sound Supports the Mind–Body Connection
item.description: Interoception is the sense that helps us notice internal body signals such as heartbeat, breathing, muscle tension, temperature, and more. item.description: In elementary classrooms, challenges with impulse control, following directions, and staying focused are often viewed as behavior problems. item.title: Understanding Stimming: Why Kids Do It and How We Can Support Them
item.description: Stimming is a natural and meaningful way many children regulate their bodies, emotions, attention, and social experiences.
